احتقروا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَرُوا (iḥtaqarū) /iħ.ta.qa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اُحْتُقِرُوا (uḥtuqirū) /uħ.tu.qi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اِحْتَقِرُوا (iḥtaqirū) /iħ.ta.qi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
